parts.title: 1 - The Trail
parts.prompt: Premium stylized 3D animated fantasy film, vertical 9:16, feature-film quality. A beautiful forest clearing at twilight: deep blue-green shadows, soft mist above the grass, warm amber light through the branches, tiny golden particles drifting in the air. The boy has messy chestnut-brown hair, large bright green eyes, a red-and-dark-green plaid overshirt over a cream T-shirt, dark jeans and red-brown sneakers with white soles; keep his face, hair, eye color and outfit exactly the same. A tiny glowing golden butterfly with translucent wings flutters back down into frame and circles the boy once, then drifts toward the dark trees and pauses in mid-air, as if waiting for him. The boy hesitates, glances back over his shoulder, then smiles and follows it. With every step he takes, small flowers along the mossy path light up with a soft golden glow under his sneakers, leaving a glowing trail behind him. The camera tracks low beside him with smooth parallax through foreground ferns, then rises to reveal what lies ahead: an enormous ancient hollow tree with twisting roots, and at its base a tiny round wooden door with warm golden light glowing through its keyhole. The boy stops, his eyes widen and his mouth opens slightly in wonder. Natural breathing, realistic cloth movement, subtle facial acting. Sound: soft footsteps on moss, a delicate crystal chime each time a flower lights up, a distant owl, gentle piano and soft strings.

parts.title: 2 - The Tiny Door
parts.prompt: Premium stylized 3D animated fantasy film, vertical 9:16, feature-film quality. Twilight forest at the base of an enormous ancient hollow tree, deep blue shadows, soft mist, warm golden light. The boy has messy chestnut-brown hair, large bright green eyes, a red-and-dark-green plaid overshirt over a cream T-shirt, dark jeans and red-brown sneakers; keep his face and outfit exactly the same. He kneels down in front of a tiny round wooden door set between the roots. The small glowing golden butterfly lands on the tiny brass doorknob and slowly opens and closes its wings. The boy gently knocks on the door with one fingertip. A beat of silence. Then the tiny door creaks open and warm golden light spills out across his face. Dozens of tiny glowing butterflies stream out of the doorway and rise in a graceful spiral around him, lifting strands of his hair and lighting his face, hands and plaid shirt with warm reflected light. He laughs softly with delight, eyes sparkling, as the butterflies dance around his outstretched hands. Close-up on his face with shallow depth of field, then a slow orbit as the spiral of light swirls around him. Restrained bloom, delicate glowing trails. Sound: a soft wooden creak, a cascade of crystalline chimes, gentle fluttering wings, a small genuine giggle, strings and magical bells swelling warmly.

parts.title: 3 - The Shadow
parts.prompt: Premium stylized 3D animated fantasy film, vertical 9:16, feature-film quality. Twilight forest clearing in front of an enormous ancient hollow tree. The boy has messy chestnut-brown hair, large bright green eyes, a red-and-dark-green plaid overshirt over a cream T-shirt, dark jeans and red-brown sneakers; keep his face and outfit exactly the same. Suddenly a cold gust of wind sweeps through the trees. The swirling golden butterflies scatter in fright and rush back into the tiny glowing door at the base of the tree, and the tiny door slams shut. The warm light drains away and the forest turns a deep, cold moonlit blue. A huge dark shadow glides over the clearing, bending the treetops. High up between the dark trees, two enormous round glowing eyes slowly open and look down at the boy. The boy stumbles back in fear, then stops, clenches his fists, plants his feet and spreads his arms wide, standing bravely in front of the tiny door to protect it. His face is scared but determined, his hair and shirt whipping in the wind. Camera: fast push-in on his determined face, then a dramatic low angle looking up past his shoulder at the giant glowing eyes in the darkness. Sound: a deep rumble, rushing wind and leaves, a slow heavy heartbeat drum, tense low strings, then the music drops to silence.

parts.title: 4 - The Twist
parts.prompt: Premium stylized 3D animated fantasy film, vertical 9:16, feature-film quality. Moonlit twilight forest clearing, deep blue atmosphere with soft mist. The boy has messy chestnut-brown hair, large bright green eyes, a red-and-dark-green plaid overshirt over a cream T-shirt, dark jeans and red-brown sneakers; keep his face and outfit exactly the same. The giant creature leans slowly out of the darkness into the moonlight, and it is not a monster: it is an enormous, gentle, fluffy guardian moth made of soft golden light, with huge kind eyes and wide shimmering wings, the mother of the little butterfly. The tiny glowing butterfly flies up and lands on her giant nose. The boy slowly lowers his arms, amazed. The guardian bows her head to him and softly breathes out a single tiny golden spark, which floats down and settles into his open palm. He closes his fingers around it, and for a moment his bright green eyes flash with golden light. He looks straight at the camera with a small, warm, knowing smile. The guardian rises into the sky with the little butterfly, and the whole forest lights up gold around him. The camera slowly pulls back to a wide magical shot of the glowing forest, then the image fades gently to black. Sound: a warm deep hum, a soaring orchestral swell with soft piano, delicate strings and magical bells, a tiny crystal chime as the spark lands, ending on one gentle, satisfying piano note.
